name: Folgertech FT-6 0.6 nozzle
pre_gcode: M140 S{bed_temp}   ; p3d: need to heat the bed
M190 S{bed_temp}   ; p3d: wait for bed temperature
M104 S{temp}       ; p3d: need to heat the nozzle
M109 S{temp}       ; p3d: wait for nozzle temperature
G1 X0 Y5 Z0.2 F3000 ; Get ready to prime
G1 X250 E20 F600 ; Prime nozzle
post_gcode: G28 X Y ; Home X and Y axis
M84 X Y E ; disable motors
fan_gcode: M106 S{fan_speed}  ; p3d: add for orca slicer
